findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess calls in python-dotenv
 * @description Find all subprocess calls in the package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/subprocess-calls
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen", "run"]).getACall()
select call, "Subprocess call found"
findings.hypothesis: Check for subprocess calls that could be vulnerable to shell injection
